reviews.comment: Lectures are completely useless. Exams are very difficult and are unlike any of the practice exams he provides. The only redeeming quality of Dr. Kundu is his ability to curve. I failed this class miserably and ended up with a B. Every exam I took was a failing grade and it was curved to either a A or B.

This was the worst class I have ever taken. Lectures were confusing, homework had extremely difficult questions on proofs, and the tests had ridiculous questions and were nothing like the practice tests we were given. Overall, though he does curve, this class was incredibly stressful and I implore you to take another professor if possible.

Worst. Prof. Ever. This man had the most useless notes and lectures consisted of him reading from the slide. While the homework assigned was manageable it had absolutely no connection to the tests given. On top of this, the tests were ridiculously hard to the point he had to add huge curves to make the distribution seem reasonable.

Y'all get the idea by the other ratings but I took this class because math wasn't my thing and my academic advisor recommended it. However, with this prof, it was one of the hardest classes I've taken. Tests are way harder than homework and practice exams. Even with the major curving on every test, final included, it really wasn't worth the stress.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He doesn't give the impression that he knows what he 's doing. The exams often include questions that won't be on the practice exam. He also has to curve every exam because everyone does so poorly. Also, don't expect to have enough time to complete your final exam. This simple class left me feeling dumb and inadequate.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I never went to lectures, not helpful at all. Expected students to be stat geniuses right away and would make us feel stupid for not knowing stuff. Only reason I got an A was because of the heavy curve. Ex; made a 50 on a midterm, curved to an 80. Do not take him, the curve (however large it may be) was not worth the stress from that class :(

he needs to understand that students who are just learning stats for the first time are not going to be geniuses and to have patience with them rather than making them feel stupid. horrible experience

worst professor i have ever had. His class was a complete joke and the only reason people didn't fail was because he gave 25+ curves on every test. This class was so unnecessarily stressful and I wouldn't want my worst enemy to have to endure the utter BS that his class was. 0/10 would rather die than take him again

I had signed up for a different prof at the beginning of the semester but got switched to him for some reason. I didn't go to class after the first week as he literally just read from the pp or made us even more confused. The tests were difficult even with the studying, but he curved like crazy cuz entire class did bad. ended with an A with curves

I was stuck with him when my professors got switched and he was awful. He makes students feel stupid for concepts they don't understand. He gives practice exams that are no where near close to the difficulty of the exams. His lectures are pointless. The only reason I ended with a 98 is because I read the textbook and he gives outrageous curves.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: To be real this was a really hard class with him. I think he has a tough time lecturing and assumes the class just automatically understands. I gotta give him respect though, he curved every single exam and even though I made around 60s for all of them I still ended up with an A in the class. Probably wouldn't take him again but he came in clutch.

His lectures were hard to follow at some points and I learned more by going through the lecture slides myself than listening to him go through them. All of the tests had huge curves on them. You're better off trying to teach yourself than taking his class.

He can be hard to reach out of class, but he is nice during lectures. They are sometimes hard to follow, especially with them being online. I learned mostly by doing practice problems. He curves the exams a TON! Mainly because there is issues with questions. I feel like I haven't learned a ton, but that maybe because it is online. Not easy class
